assets.name: 페르구사 호수
assets.subject: Lake Pergusa near Enna in inland Sicily: a broad shallow oval lake enclosed by low rolling cultivated hills, spring wildflowers and tall reeds, olives and distant oak groves; no sea, no mountains, no cars, no racetrack. Evoke the traditional landscape of Persephone picking flowers, without showing gods or a literal supernatural abduction.

assets.name: 킬레네산의 헤르메스 동굴
assets.subject: The real limestone Cave of Hermes high on Mount Kyllene, also called Ziria, in northern Peloponnese: rocky alpine mountainside with sparse fir trees, a small natural opening leading down to spacious rough limestone chambers with stalactites and stalagmites. No constructed temple, carved doorway, giant deity, baby, gold treasure, modern stairs or electric lighting.

assets.name: 이리아의 디오니소스 성역
assets.subject: The archaic Sanctuary of Dionysus at Yria on Naxos: a modest rectangular white Naxian marble Ionic temple with exactly four columns on its front porch, simple low pediment and pitched tiled roof, plain cella, outdoor marble altar and nearby low ceremonial dining building, on a fertile green island plain with vineyards and distant low hills. Keep its modest four-column scale, never a giant Parthenon. A restrained archaeological reconstruction of the sixth-century BCE sanctuary.

assets.name: 사모스의 헤라 신전
assets.subject: The great Heraion of Samos on a low coastal alluvial plain: a colossal elongated rectangular archaic Ionic dipteral temple, two encircling rows of very tall slender fluted columns with Ionic volutes, a broad column-filled porch and large open sacred precinct, eastern Aegean hills and pale blue sea far behind. A consistent restrained reconstruction of the sixth-century BCE Rhoikos temple with terracotta pitched roof; do not show a Doric Parthenon or place it atop a cliff.

assets.name: 렘노스의 헤파이스티아 유적
assets.subject: Ancient Hephaistia on Lemnos: a modest classical Greek harbor town on a low coastal peninsula overlooking Pournias Bay, a small stone hillside theatre, terracotta-roofed courtyard houses, pottery kiln workshops, a small agora and harbor quays. This is a town, not a single monumental temple; no invented giant Hephaestus statue, lava eruption or glowing fantasy forge. A coherent archaeological reconstruction with coastal town layout preserved throughout.

assets.name: 아레티아스 — 아레스의 섬
assets.subject: Giresun Island, ancient Aretias, a tiny low rocky green island off the forested southern Black Sea coast: a compact wooded knoll, weathered Byzantine stone perimeter walls and ruined low masonry partly hidden in vegetation, a few dark shoreline rocks, grey-blue Black Sea and distant hazy green Pontic hills. Seabirds are small and natural. The legendary Amazon sanctuary of Ares may be suggested only by a small unroofed stone enclosure and dark natural altar rock, no surviving grand temple, no giant statue, no oversized birds, no modern city skyline.

assets.name: 로마의 베스타 신전
assets.subject: Temple of Vesta in the ancient Roman Forum: a small circular marble tholos on a round stepped podium, exactly twenty slender Corinthian columns encircling a round cella, a low conical roof with a central smoke opening, sacred hearth inside, weathered Roman paving and modest nearby brick buildings. Keep its distinctive circular plan throughout, not the rectangular temple at Tivoli, no Pantheon dome, no giant deity. Restrained reconstruction of the Roman imperial temple; the present archaeological ruin should appear in the final morning view.
